releaseNotes: [AI engine reconstruction] The built-in basic AI engine is ready for use out of the box, and you can optionally enable advanced AI engines (Ying core/cloud) to enhance analysis on demand.
[Friendly for low-end computers] It can run smoothly even without independent graphics cards and low memory. It rebuilds the high-speed AI infrastructure with CPU inference as the core.
[Independent advanced AI engine] Firefly AI ​​engine can run independently from the main program, providing AI capabilities for third-party applications other than Firefly
[Video Search] Pictures, audios, and videos can be accurately retrieved by natural language, and search by semantics, pictures, and voice content are supported.
[Speech to text ASR] Conversations and podcast content in videos and audios are quickly converted into text for easy retrieval and archiving.
[Speech Synthesis TTS] One-click text-to-speech, built-in more than 50 tones, supports 3-second custom tone cloning, and can directly listen to novels and documents
[File Label Upgrade] Newly added richer fact label types, the labels are more accurate and explainable
[Special optimization of multimedia materials] For designers and self-media creators, special enhancements are made for the organization of pictures, audio, and video materials.

[NSFW Special Optimization] More accurate detection, segmentation and enhancement of sensitive content such as pornography, violence, terrorism, politics, violations, insults, and blood in pictures, videos, and audios

[Multi-mode batch sorting] Five modes: identity blueprint, intelligent clustering, external AI generated directory structure, directory tree derivation from files, and customized directory tree. Generate directories and classify thousands of files in seconds.

[Identity Blueprint (Recommended)] Select an identity from the industry and life role database, and after four stages of fine tuning, the client and side will match the high-quality directory structure in milliseconds.
[Intelligent Clustering] End-side unsupervised clustering (HAC), directly outputs the compiled directory tree in milliseconds, and supports instant inline fine-tuning
[Directory structure generated by external AI] One-click to copy the prompt words to external AI such as Doubao, ChatGPT, Kimi, etc., and paste the results to preview and organize them in real time

[Deriving directory trees from files] With the help of advanced AI engine, 3 sets of complete directory tree candidates are directly given from local or cloud large models, and they can be classified by selecting them.
[Customized directory tree] Paste or handwrite the Markdown directory structure, preview the left and right columns in real time, and build an exclusive organization solution on demand
[In-depth UI optimization] Reorganize the information structure such as the settings page, add a new guidance and help entrance, and make the operation more intuitive
